title: Slave Dynasty Iltutmish
definition: Shams-ud-din Iltutmish (1211–1236 AD) was the third ruler of the Mamluk dynasty, widely regarded as the 'Real Founder' of the Delhi Sultanate for consolidating the empire and securing legal recognition from the Caliphate.
importanceInUpsc: Iltutmish is a perennial favorite for UPSC due to his institutional innovations (Iqta, Chahalgani) and his role in transitioning the Sultanate from a military camp to a stable administrative state.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Slave Dynasty Iltutmish.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
